S007-01.notes: 'not settled so much as ___' plus 'sides make compatible claims' = the debate vanishes as a pseudo-dispute: dissolved. 'resolved' is the trap (contrasted with 'settled').

S007-02.notes: Self-domestication claims humans had no deliberate breeding role early; evidence of confinement and selective breeding from the start directly contradicts it. D supports; B, C irrelevant/weakly supportive.

flags: minor: distractors A-C are clearly unsupported overreaches, so base-rate reasoning is barely tested; D is also the longest choice
S007-03.notes: Same 80% rate in patients and general population means no association; survey is weak evidence of risk.

S007-04.notes: 'Although...promising' is a dependent clause attaching to 'a safety concern emerged'; a sentence break is needed after 'early'. B creates a comma splice (trap), C misplaces comma after 'although', D is a run-on.

S007-05.notes: Second sentence gives specific detail of the 'modest' effect. Nevertheless/Even so wrongly signal contrast; Consequently wrongly signals cause.

flags: minor: 'similarity' maps to the only choice with 'both', making the item very transparent
S007-06.notes: Only B states a shared method.

S007-07.notes: Conclusion is an interaction: fertilizer helps only with high water. C contrasts both conditions; B gives only the low-water half; A and D address water/max yield, not the fertilizer effect's dependence on water. Data check: 30->38->46 and 20/21/20 correct.

S007-08.notes: Catalog gives only bare-bones info (date, sender) and no content: skeletal. 'exhaustive' traps on 'every letter'; nothing suggests inaccuracy or illegibility.

S007-09.notes: Subject is singular 'the number', so 'has risen'; 'species' is the intervening-plural trap. B and C are not grammatical with 'risen' as finite verb (C would be passive-ish nonsense).
